what: ADR-0090 §1 — where the 20 Sep planners' new tokens went: harness, reading, or their own output
instrument: scripts/planner-decompose.py, over the two subagent transcripts results/planner-cost-2026-09-19.json and results/planner-cost-n41-2026-09-20.json name by their stable suffix. No planner was re-run.
identity: P_total ≈ harness + reading + 2 × output. Output is paid twice under P_total: once as output, once as the next message's cache write. The residual is negative by about the last message's output, which is never re-sent.

ceilings_at_N12.label: arithmetic on measured terms, not a measurement of any retrieval arm

not_measured: The split of output into visible text and thinking. Thinking is stored redacted; visible output (text + tool inputs) is ~67k characters at N=12 and ~113k at N=41, so thinking is most of the output. Estimated, not measured.
classifier_correction: The first version of scripts/planner-decompose.py classified Bash calls by substring, and a scratchpad path contains this project's name, so ad-hoc analysis scripts and greps run from one were filed as 'sidecrew'. Reclassified by program the same day, before anything was committed: sidecrew's own output is 1.8 % / 2.8 % of reading, not 12 % / 33 %. The harness/reading/output split is unaffected.
